title: Governance 2.2.0 multiformat promotion
objective: Settle Governance 2.2.0 as a reviewable release that keeps JSON Schema validation authoritative and adds deterministic YAML and bounded GraphQL retrieval projections.

work_items.desired_state: The promotion-receipt family offers deterministic YAML and a read-only GraphQL interface while the JSON Schema remains its validation authority.
entry_evidence: The accepted Governance 2.1.0 promotion-receipt schema and Issue 21 supply the source family and intended retrieval formats.
completion_evidence: YAML generation reproduces the canonical JSON data model with deterministic bytes.
The authored GraphQL SDL composes as a query-only interface and every projected field retains a directly mapped source property.
The exact coverage ledger accounts for all 195 reachable source constraints.

work_items.desired_state: Representative downstream records validate with the Governance 2.2.0 candidate and make every required release-metadata update visible before adoption.
entry_evidence: The four named downstream repositories currently bind the accepted Governance 2.1.0 coordinate.
completion_evidence: Each representative document either validates directly or records its bounded 2.2.0 metadata migration.
The rehearsal preserves accepted 2.1.0 pins until the 2.2.0 tag, commit, and archive digest exist.

work_items.desired_state: Governance 2.2.0 identifies its annotated tag object, accepted commit, reproducible archive digest, schema release, and downstream adoption path.
entry_evidence: The release candidate carries coherent version metadata, migration guidance, examples, projection proof, and root orientation records.
completion_evidence: The complete local proof and downstream contract rehearsal pass at the release candidate.
A governed release branch targets main and becomes the signed, annotated governance-v2.2.0 release.
A later evidence commit records the tag object, accepted commit, archive digest, and their ancestry relationship.
The Machine Node replaces candidate zeros with the accepted commit and archive digest.
Two accepted-source Governance Pages builds match byte for byte before publication.
Downstream adoption guidance names the promoted schema and workflow coordinates.

reentry_capsule.current_state: Governance 2.1.0 remains accepted while the 2.2.0 candidate carries complete multiformat source and awaits downstream rehearsal and protected promotion.
reentry_capsule.next_safe_action: Run the downstream contract rehearsal, complete protected release review, then record the accepted tag, commit, and archive digest from a later evidence carrier.
reentry_capsule.verification: Confirm Governance 2.2.0 schema and example conformance, deterministic YAML equality, GraphQL source binding, the exact coverage ledger, downstream compatibility, and candidate promotion coherence.

retained_effects: Governance 2.1.0 remains the accepted release until the 2.2.0 promotion supplies an observed coordinate.
JSON Schema remains the machine-validation authority for promotion receipts.
Stable schema identifiers remain in the /v2.0/ family while package metadata advances.
The downstream JSON-only validation path remains dependency-free.
Ordinary validation and accountable review continue for automated maintenance.
consequential_questions: Which downstream repository should receive the observed Governance 2.2.0 coordinate first?
Which material-use evidence would support a later decision to advance the projection family beyond candidate standing?
